entries.note: Australia Post's first row for the article id, copied before Anhua has the parcel.

entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.english: The electronic cargo information has been received
entries.note: The platform's order row: the shipment's data received. The English is the platform's own, as its other tenants write it.
Anhua's warehouse in Guangzhou collects the parcel, its first scan in Anhua's hands.
The parcel leaves the operation centre in Guangzhou.

entries.wording: Sent to the transit warehouse at the port
entries.note: The platform's custom track row: sent on to the port's transit warehouse. Listed as a planned step.
The receiving point in Shenzhen, after Guangzhou's collection and departure: the parcel goes on towards Hong Kong.

entries.english: Declared for the crossing into Hong Kong
entries.note: The declaration for the crossing from Shenzhen into Hong Kong, with the batch, a day and a letter, read as an ellipsis. A routine step before the flight, not a hold.

entries.english: Arrived in Hong Kong, booking a flight
entries.note: In Hong Kong, waiting for a flight.

entries.wording: Shipping information approved by Australia Post
entries.note: Australia Post accepts the shipment's data, copied from its record while the parcel waits in Hong Kong for its flight. A notice, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.english: Expected on the flight of the …
entries.note: Names the day of the flight booked for the parcel, read as an ellipsis, before it flies. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.english: Landed, clearing customs and collecting the goods
entries.note: Landed in Australia, with the import clearance under way.
The import clearance done: the parcel goes on.

entries.english: Scanned on handover to the delivery warehouse
entries.note: Handed in after the clearance, before Australia Post's pickup.

entries.wording: Your consignment has been picked up
entries.note: Australia Post picks the parcel up from the line, its first scan, copied from its record.
Australia Post's delivery, copied with the name of whoever signed after it, which the adapter drops.
